scientific_question: Can the near-full-rank v178 training-field affine coordinates be recovered from deployment-visible five-camera observations and reported geometry alone, without p22 truth, trajectory identity, time, or a learned model, and does one unchanged CGLS K1 step preserve the recovered field under the frozen accuracy gate?
role: post-open observation-and-geometry-only identifiability diagnostic on the four already-open p22-s01 frames; the complete p22 trajectory is excluded from every fit field, affine basis, solver choice, threshold, and geometry cache
physical_distinction: v179 inverts the measurement action of the frozen v178 fit-field affine basis. It is not a renamed local dual residual joint least-squares control: its unknowns are the 1009 global training-field coordinates, its columns are exact forward projections of orthonormal three-dimensional field directions, and its output is a full three-dimensional field before unchanged CGLS.

data_isolation.fit_source: inherit exactly the ten complete train-split trajectories and 1010 transformed fields bound by v178
data_isolation.heldout_source: inherit exactly p=22kw_size=01 and the four already-open frame indices 0,25,75,100 bound by v178
heldout_truth_allowed_only_for: synthetic observation generation through the frozen forward operator
final field and gradient scoring after observation-only candidates are sealed

affine_basis.definition: rebuild the v178 arithmetic fit mean and direct thin-SVD basis from the same 1010 transformed fit fields
affine_basis.sign_canonicalization: largest-absolute field entry is nonnegative; ties use the lowest flat index

measurement_inverse_primary.name: affine_measurement_pseudoinverse
measurement_inverse_primary.per_geometry_matrix: M_c = A_c U^T, where each row of U is one frozen orthonormal affine field direction
measurement_inverse_primary.coordinate_rule: minimum-Euclidean-norm truncated direct-SVD solution a = M_c^+ r_y
measurement_inverse_primary.floor_origin: sqrt(float64 machine epsilon), fixed before any v179 measurement spectrum or candidate is computed
measurement_inverse_primary.regularization: none beyond the fixed numerical singular-value floor
measurement_inverse_primary.fallback: if no measurement singular direction survives, mark the run inconclusive; never substitute the mean or a control

cheap_deterministic_control.name: affine_coordinate_cgls1
cheap_deterministic_control.definition: from zero coordinates compute g=M_c^T r_y and one exact steepest-descent/CGLS step a=beta*g with beta=(g^Tg)/((M_c g)^T(M_c g)); denominator floor 1e-30

static_control.name: fit_mean
static_control.definition: the same frozen v178 fit mean before and after one unchanged physical CGLS K1 step

evaluation.sensor_control: the same six field arms on all_nine
evaluation.subset_rule: reuse the immutable minimal_shared_gram_ridge five-camera subset index frozen before p22 truth was opened in v176
evaluation.physical_k1_rule: one unmodified identity-preconditioned CGLS step from the supplied field using the exact current residual; denominator floor 1e-30

frozen_operator.forward: same calibrated exact-adjoint straight-ray density-gradient proxy as v176-v178

exact_call_ledger.measurement_cache_per_sensor_and_calibra: 1009 basis-direction forward-equivalent projections plus one fit-mean projection; always reported as geometry setup, never hidden in the online ledger
exact_call_ledger.truth_observation: one excluded offline forward per sensor arm, calibration, and frame

required_validity_gates: all v178 parent identities and decisions unchanged
all fit, p22, calibration, subset, selection, and source trees unchanged
affine rank exactly 1009 and basis orthogonality within 1e-7
measurement matrices finite with the expected observation-by-1009 shapes
retained measurement rank is nonzero and no fallback occurs
direct-SVD normalized stationarity within 1e-7 and reconstruction identities within 1e-10
candidate arrays are sealed before final truth scoring
fixed-observation heldout-truth mutation leaves all coordinates and candidates byte-identical
camera permutation changes neither field candidate nor coordinate solution beyond 1e-10
all exact-call and geometry-cache receipts equal the frozen ledger
formal and input trees remain unchanged
independent second implementation passes every required comparison

must_independently_rebuild: the ten fit input identities, 1010 transformed fields, fit mean, and 1009-direction affine basis
the thirteen calibrations, frozen five-camera selections, all-nine operators, and measurement matrices
direct-SVD pseudoinverse coordinates and one-step coordinate-CGLS controls from observations only
all sealed candidate fields before reading formal candidate arrays
physical K0/K1 replay, all 624 metric rows, exact-call receipts, calibration and frame tails, and decision

decision_order: Any identity, isolation, affine-basis, measurement-matrix, rank, SVD, stationarity, observation-only, mutation, selection, operator, adjoint, permutation, K1, call-ledger, finite, seal, or independent-recomputation failure makes v179 inconclusive.

If affine_measurement_pseudoinverse_k0 fails on both the frozen five-camera arm and all-nine control, conclude FAIL_AFFINE_COORDINATES_NOT_OBSERVABLE_V179 and close the near-full-rank affine measurement inverse.
If pseudoinverse K0 passes all-nine but fails the frozen five-camera arm, conclude FAIL_FIVE_CAMERA_AFFINE_COORDINATE_OBSERVABILITY_V179.
If pseudoinverse K0 passes the frozen five-camera arm but pseudoinverse K1 fails both sensor arms, conclude FAIL_UNCHANGED_K1_AFTER_AFFINE_MEASUREMENT_INVERSE_V179.
If pseudoinverse K1 passes all-nine but fails the frozen five-camera arm, conclude FAIL_FIVE_CAMERA_K1_AFTER_AFFINE_MEASUREMENT_INVERSE_V179.
If fit_mean K0 and K1 both pass the frozen five-camera arm, conclude PASS_STATIC_MEAN_EXPLAINS_V179 and prefer the fixed prior.

If affine_coordinate_cgls1 K0 and K1 both pass the frozen five-camera arm, conclude PASS_ONE_STEP_COORDINATE_CONTROL_EXPLAINS_V179 and prefer the cheaper deterministic control; no learned predictor is authorized.

Only if pseudoinverse K0 and K1 pass the frozen five-camera arm while both cheaper control families fail may v179 conclude PASS_AFFINE_MEASUREMENT_INVERSE_HEADROOM_V179 and authorize only a separately frozen compact observation-and-geometry-only approximation diagnostic.
No v179 outcome is a learned algorithm, neural-operator advantage, online resource saving, external generalization, curved-ray result, real BOST result, paper success, or algorithm breakthrough.
